create_class_bitmasks: create a BitMasks class instance from a 3D boolean tensor representing N segmentation masks
create_class_polygon_masks: create a PolygonMasks class instance from a list of polygon coordinate arrays per image instance
convert_polygon_to_bitmask: convert a list of polygon numpy arrays to a boolean bitmap mask of given height and width
rasterize_polygons_within_box: rasterize polygon masks within a bounding box and resize to a square mask size tensor
crop_and_resize_bitmasks: crop each bitmask by given boxes and resize results to a specified mask size
